544:t_2:86.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「...I never thought we'd meet again in a place like this...」

544:t_2:88.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Right now I'm $$コード：ホワイト$$... a strike team member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

544:t_2:90.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We have business with $$ヤムスク１１$$ here too.」

544:t_2:92.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Looks like the demolition of the facility has begun...」

544:t_2:93.en:
$n
「...Please tell me. Why is $$マキ#pilot$$ with $$クロノ$$...」

544:t_2:94.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I became a member around last April... They scouted me, saying I had potential.」

544:t_2:96.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「That's right. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

544:t_2:97.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I never thought I'd end up fighting you, though...」

544:t_2:98.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on $$翠の地球$$ a lie!?」

544:t_2:99.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I never told one.」

544:t_2:100.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I'm both the nurse $$柏葉真紀$$ and $$クロノ$$'s $$コード：ホワイト$$.」

544:t_2:101.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Until the Captain gave orders, I was just a nurse working in Japan.」

544:t_2:102.en:
$n
「What does 'change the world' even mean!? Does it have something to do with the Reformists' 'watching over humanity's evolution'!?」

544:t_2:103.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You don't need to know that. We just follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

544:t_2:104.en:
$n
「That's absurd! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what it does!?」

544:t_2:107.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain is worthy of trust... Isn't that enough?」

544:t_2:109.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good chance, $n. I'll forgive you for raising your sword against the Captain.」

544:t_2:110.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will take you in if you apologize.」

544:t_2:112.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Let's go, $n. ...Or won't you listen to my request?」

544:t_2:115.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「With the Captain and me, we can wrap you in our arms and take care of you.」

544:t_2:118.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Why can't you listen to the Captain's words...」

544:t_2:123.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The explosions have kept going this whole time... Looks like even $$レナード$$ didn't expect this...)

544:t_2:124.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Thanks to the confusion I managed to escape... Now I just need to get out of here and contact $c...)

544:t_2:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What's $$テッサ$$ doing in a place like this...?」

544:t_2:129.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I came here with Sagara, but we got caught in the explosion and separated...」

544:t_2:132.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm so glad! To be able to see you again like this!」

544:t_2:134.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Sousuke's somewhere near here too... If I can just find him...)

544:t_2:140.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never imagined I'd end up trapped in here with you...」

544:t_2:142.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well, you've got me. I never thought anyone besides me and $$テレサ$$ had set their sights on this place...」

544:t_2:143.en:
$$レナード$$
「No... 'human' might be a misleading word.」

544:t_2:145.en:
$$レナード$$
「Heh heh... what a shame. Since you can't beat me in an AS, now is your best chance to kill me, and you have to throw it away.」

544:t_2:146.en:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to have grown crude in the time since I last saw you.」

544:t_2:147.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Let's stop. We agreed to a temporary truce so we could get out of here.」

544:t_2:148.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you understand that, get to work. If we can't clear this rubble, at worst we'll suffocate within a few hours.」

544:t_2:151.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of answering.」

544:t_2:152.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then what would you think if I told you $$千鳥かなめ$$ is here?」

544:t_2:154.en:
$$レナード$$
「We got caught in the explosion and separated, though.」

544:t_2:156.en:
$$レナード$$
「Your hands have stopped out of worry. ...But don't worry. She's alive, for certain.」

544:t_2:157.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why can you be so sure?」

544:t_2:158.en:
$$レナード$$
「She's lucky. Almost unbelievably so.」

544:t_2:159.en:
$$宗介$$
「As if that could be grounds for anything.」

544:t_2:160.en:
$$レナード$$
「She has narrowly escaped death more times than I can count. I'd say it's strange she's still alive today.」

544:t_2:161.en:
$$宗介$$
(True, $$千鳥$$ has overcome situations many times that would chill even me, but...)

544:t_2:162.en:
$$レナード$$
「Her good luck is abnormal.」

544:t_2:163.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ has always acted without giving up. She judged what she could do within her means, and followed her strong will and convictions.」

544:t_2:164.en:
$$宗介$$
「In that sense, she's no different from an ordinary veteran soldier.」

544:t_2:165.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll admit she has an exceptional will and drive. But couldn't it be seen this way?」

544:t_2:166.en:
$$レナード$$
「That having such abilities was itself part of her good fortune.」

544:t_2:168.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well, perhaps so. It's a circular word game.」

544:t_2:169.en:
$$レナード$$
「Besides, the reason she hasn't died is not luck but inevitability.」

544:t_2:143 referent of the 語弊 remark.
